name: Supertrend triple-confirmation (3 Supertrend indicators must agree)
one_line: Enter when three Supertrend indicators (different ATR period/multiplier) are all 'up'; exit when three 'down'.

source.license: GPL-3.0 (repo LICENSE). Only ideas are summarised here; no code copied.

idea: Supertrend = ATR-band trailing line; three instances with different (multiplier, period) must agree; trailing stop + wide -26.5% stoploss.
rationale: ATR-adaptive trend following; agreement reduces whipsaws.
evidence: Shipped parameters come from hyperopt (in-sample); no out-of-sample data in the repo.
limitations: three correlated indicators: some are likely redundant (ablation candidate)

pipeline_fit.notes: Pick fixed a-priori multiplier=3, period=10 style values; do not hyperopt.
